dkwInflationExpected5.sourceTitle: Tips from TIPS: Update and Discussions
dkwInflationExpected5.calculation: Published DKW model estimate in native percentage points; no rescaling. Fitted compensation = expected inflation + inflation risk premium − TIPS liquidity premium.
dkwInflationExpected5.coverageNote: Published D’Amico–Kim–Wei staff term-structure model output, updated by Kim, Walsh and Wei. Daily estimated values, updated monthly; not an official statistical release or an observed expectation. Fitted inflation compensation = expected inflation + inflation risk premium − TIPS liquidity premium. Native percentage points, no annualization or scale conversion. Latest revised full-sample model vintage.
dkwInflationExpected5.attribution: Source: D’Amico, Kim and Wei (2018), updated by Kim, Walsh and Wei (2019), Federal Reserve Board FEDS Notes.
dkwInflationExpected5.modelReleaseNote:
Components of 5- and 10-year nominal yields and inflation compensation and 5-to-10-year nominal forward rate and forward inflation compensation.
 
Source: 
D'Amico, Kim, and Wei (2018), "Tips from TIPS: The Informational Content of Treasury Inflation-Protected Security Prices," 
updated by Kim, Walsh, and Wei (2019), FEDS notes, "Tips from TIPS: Update and Discussions."
 
The latest data can be downloaded from :
https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/DKW_updates.csv
 
Notes: 
Data are updated monthly; all rates are in percentage points.
This release is based on a model re-estimation using data through November 12, 2025.  Other changes relative to the Kim, Walsh, and Wei (2019) FEDS note include using 1-year survey inflation forecasts from Blue Chip Financial Forecasts (monthly) instead of 1-year survey inflation forecasts from Survey of Professional Forecasters (quarterly) and adding 15- and 20-year nominal and TIPS yields to the estimation.
This is not an official Federal Reserve statistical release. Because this is a staff research product and not an official statistical release, it is subject to delay, revision, or methodological changes without advance notice.
